supersedes.why_superseded: The v1 receipt compared only Git-level code provenance between the capture-governing commit and HEAD. It never evaluated whether the captured bytes themselves are a valid capture. They are not: the t01 raw capture is temporally misaligned, so code-provenance compatibility is moot.

code_provenance_finding_retained.comment: The v1 code-level classification is not disputed. It is simply not sufficient.

capture_validity_finding.interpretation: The median screenshot was taken roughly twenty-one server ticks after the tick it is joined to. Frame-to-world correspondence is not recoverable from the recorded bytes.

disposition_reason: The existing raw bytes cannot support a valid frame-to-tick join, so no post-capture processing of them can be scientifically valid. Recapture must reuse the identical frozen spec id regime_a_v1_t01, frozen seed 1932859534325097948, and frozen spec hash f8649d4a3810b99e5f21a0ebf230220af3dfc026373c954b4eb6a63ac49c49c0.
